name: Darkness Falls: Signals
source:
Detectives Blake and Won investigate a murder that doesn't seem to have a motive. Of course, this is Sangrive, where "the most unlikely explanation isn't as weird as reality."

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/tora/posts/darkness-falls-159781983]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
布莱克和温侦探调查了一起似乎没有动机的谋杀案。当然，这里是桑格里夫，“最不可能的解释并不像现实那么奇怪”。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/tora/posts/darkness-falls-159781983]Patreon[/url]]
